cinematic_dialogue:2:1410313001:.text: To our good health, General Hogan!

narration:4:1410314001:2.text: Hogan gets knocked out, and the communicator you gave him doesn't stay hidden for long...
narration:4:1410314001:2.source_cn: 霍根被毒晕了过去，你赠予他的通讯器随后也被搜了出来……

cinematic_dialogue:6:1410313001:.text: To our good health, General Hogan!

say:9:1410314002:1.text: Chief, we found this on the general. It's quite similar to our own technology.
say:9:1410314002:1.source_cn: 弗林，我们在霍根身上找到了这个，看起来也是我们的技术。

say:11:1410314003:1.text: A flimsy trinket from an untrustworthy source. Destroy it.
say:11:1410314003:1.source_cn: 嗤，旁门左道的小玩意儿，销毁吧。

say:12:1410314004:0.text: And make sure the general gets handed over to our partners—clean and quiet, just like we discussed.
say:12:1410314004:0.source_cn: 记得把霍根交给我们亲爱的合作伙伴，我相信他们会处理干净的。

say:13:1410314005:0.text: Do you really think the Empire will just let this go?
say:13:1410314005:0.source_cn: 特使被我们……耀光那边能交代得了吗？

say:14:1410314006:0.text: Don't be so quick to underestimate our friends, Roban. Our partners have a way of making things disappear.
say:14:1410314006:0.source_cn: 别忘了，我们的合作伙伴可不止地底那群灰老鼠。

say:15:1410314007:0.text: It's time for our allies in Savannah to pay their dues. Let's see how they handle it.
say:15:1410314007:0.source_cn: 赛凡纳的朋友也该回报点什么了。

narration:17:14010322:0.text: Roban brings over the wine, poison and all. Hogan takes a swig, grins, and then passes out.
narration:17:14010322:0.source_cn: 矮人隆多拿来美酒，谁知酒里有毒，霍根喝下后晕了过去。
